title: bureau-to-workout
description: Reference code for the preprint "From Bureau to Workout: Credit Scoring and Causal Debt Resolution under Policy-Shaped Labels". Credit-risk models learn from labels that the credit system itself produces: selection at approval, masking of arrears by a moratorium, and treatment by workout offers. The repository contains a credit-bureau simulator and an asset-management workout simulator that keep counterfactual outcomes, and an estimator for each mechanism: bureau-augmented reject inference, masking-aware delayed labels, and a cross-fitted DR-learner with budget-constrained offer policies and off-policy evaluation. All data are synthetic.
